title: Isandro and the Deadline
author: Zephyrine Fairweather
blurb: Tamsin Eastwick, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
